claims.text: SPA's English release datelined Makkah, Ramadan 26, 1438 / June 21, 2017 translates the same order without printing its number: it relieves Mohammed bin Naif of the posts of Crown Prince, Deputy Premier and Minister of Interior; selects Mohammed bin Salman as Crown Prince and Deputy Premier, continuing as Minister of Defense; recites the Allegiance-Pledge Commission's support by 31 of 34; and dates the Deputy Crown Prince order 10/6/1436 AH.
claims.locator: Dateline; recital; items First and Second; trailer (11:14 local time)
claims.uncertainty: A translation that adds no event; the Arabic original (sa_spa_order_a255_20170621_ar) carries the events.

scope_note: SPA English translation of Royal Order A/255. Used for SA-EXEC-07, including the finding that the 10/6/1436 AH date is not a translation error.
